#### Bookmarking
----------------

A way to take a snapshot of your current work in Carnation so that you can continue where you left off later or share it with collaborators.


**Key Points**

- Bookmarks are stored on the server. When you make a bookmark, everyone who has access to that analysis will be able to see and load that bookmark.
- Links to bookmarks will only work for people who already have access to that analysis.
- If you adjust settings on multiple plots, bookmarking will save all of them.
- To clear or "unload" a bookmark, load an analysis the original way with the "Go!" button. To be completely sure that everything is fresh, start a new session without following a bookmark link.


**To Load**
- Select your project and analysis, if there are bookmarks for that analysis a table will appear. Click on one of them and then press "Load".
- After loading a bookmark, refreshing the page will take you back to the state the bookmark loaded into.

**To Save**
- Then, to make a bookmark, click the "Bookmark" button at the top right of the screen. This will bring up a menu that has a place to enter a label for your bookmark.
- If a bookmark is already loaded, the bookmark field will start filled with that bookmark's label for you to edit,
- This pop up menu also has a list of the other existing bookmarks for that analysis in case you want to do a variation on an existing label. Clicking on one of them will place its label in the field.
